Bug_Title: Nm: Class defines tostring(); should it be toString()? (NM_LCASE_TOSTRING)
Bug_Details:
This class defines a method called tostring().  This method
does not override the toString() method in java.lang.Object,
which is probably what was intended. tostring() toString() java.lang.Object
Bug_Explanation: The class defines a method 'tostring()' instead of 'toString()'. This does not override the 'toString()' method in java.lang.Object, leading to potential confusion and unexpected behavior when the 'toString()' method is intended to be overridden.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method, which in turn calls the toString method on the ToStringBugExample object. Due to the incorrect method name 'tostring()', the custom string representation is not returned, and the default Object's toString() method is called. This results in a failure of the test case assertion.
